23.text: Medium shot panning down as Juliana reaches into her deep apron pocket and pulls out a worn, leather-bound notebook.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "This is not simply old age."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Quick reaction shot of Prudence staring with wide, bewildered eyes.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting at the foot of the bed, carefully opening the leather journal across her lap and flipping through hand-annotated botanical pages.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up overhead of the yellowed parchment, showing botanical sketches of toxic herbs and handwritten diagnostic notes as Juliana's finger traces along the script.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Juliana draws in a sharp, startled breath, her eyes widening in horror.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "Mother."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: PRUDENCE
23.text: "What is it?"

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Prudence staring back in stunned disbelief.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "I have seen these symptoms before."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: PRUDENCE
23.text: "What are you saying?"

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "Someone is poisoning her."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: PRUDENCE
23.text: "Poison?"

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "Arsenic."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: PRUDENCE
23.text: "Can you save her?"

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium shot of Juliana uncorking a glass apothecary bottle as the Duchess rests behind her.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "I can try."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Top-down close-up of Juliana's soot-smudged hands pouring powdered activated charcoal from a vial into a stone mortar, then tossing in a pinch of crushed dried leaves.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Juliana's hands vigorously grinding the pestle inside the stone mortar.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium close-up of Juliana grinding intensely, her brow furrowed as she speaks with urgent authority.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: LADY JULIANA
23.text: "The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Wide shot of the bedroom door framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess gasps in the bed.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Medium shot of Juliana freezing mid-motion, turning her head sharply toward the chamber door.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of the ornate brass door handle on the dark carved wooden door.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.speaker: PRUDENCE
23.text: "Juliana... someone is coming."

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Quick cut to Juliana looking back toward the bed and then toward the door, trapped with an unfinished cure.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's charcoal-blackened hand clutching the glass medicine vial firmly.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

23.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
23.text: Close-up on the brass door lever as it slowly rotates downward, and the heavy door cracks open inward into the room—cutting to an intense, heart-stopping cliffhanger.

24.text: Close-up of the ornate brass handle turning slowly on the dark wooden chamber door as it swings open.
Heavy metallic click of the latch and the ominous low creak of the door hinges.

Wide shot of the dimly lit, vaulted bedchamber. Lady Juliana and Prudence stand rigid beside the heavy four-poster bed as a haughty blonde noblewoman in an elegant lavender empire-line gown enters, clutching a riding crop.
The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.
Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Who are you?"
Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning."
Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?"
Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.
Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.
Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.
Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help."
Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?"
Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "She is suffering."
Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Then let her suffer."
Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "I cannot do that."
The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "You are a maid."
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Not a physician. Not a lady."
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "Yes, my lady."
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Clean it."
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "All of it, my lady?"
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

24.speaker: PRUDENCE
24.text: "My lady—"
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "Do you want the same punishment?"
Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

24.speaker: PRUDENCE
24.text: "No, my lady."
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

24.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
24.text: "That is where clever little servants belong."
Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "Let her think I am only a maid."

Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "Let her believe I am ignorant."
Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.

24.speaker: LADY JULIANA
24.text: "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

25.text: Wide tracking shot through a dense, sun-dappled forest as mist curls around towering tree trunks and tangled roots.
Juliana walks hurriedly along the leaf-strewn forest path, clutching her dark hooded cloak tightly around her shoulders, breathing heavily.
Medium low-angle shot panning up as Alexander emerges from behind a moss-covered tree, blocking the trail.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Juliana."
Close-up of Juliana stopping abruptly, her expression guarded and weary.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Why are you walking like that?"
Medium close-up of Juliana clutching the collar of her cloak with trembling fingers.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I am tired. That is all."
Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "You're hurt."
Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "It is nothing."
Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.
Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Who did this?"
Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "It does not matter."
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.
Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Who?"
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Lady Catherine."
Close-up of Alexander, his gaze piercing and hard.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Where did you meet her?"
Close-up of Juliana recounting the incident.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."
Close-up of Alexander, pressing her without hesitation.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "What were you doing there?"
Medium two-shot of Alexander leaning down toward her against the dim forest backdrop.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?"
Close-up of Juliana holding his gaze resolutely.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I went there to help someone."

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Who?"
Medium close-up profile of both of them locked in stillness.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "The Dowager Duchess."
Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "The Dowager?"
Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Prudence told me she was dying."
Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old."
Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "But it wasn't age."
Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "What did you find?"
Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Poison."
Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Arsenic."
Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.
Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.
Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly."
Close-up of Alexander processing the sinister calculation behind the poisoning.
Two-shot as Juliana looks up at him with quiet hope.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier."
Close-up of Alexander's startled gaze.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "You treated her?"

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Yes."
Close-up profile of the two facing each other.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Alone?"

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "With Prudence."
Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowed with deep protective worry.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Will you be going there again?"
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with resolute purpose.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I have to."
Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.
Two-shot of Juliana leaning in, her hand resting over Alexander's coat.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "She is still sick. I cannot leave her there."
Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.
Medium two-shot of Alexander holding Juliana's hands in the dusky woods.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his darkened face with questioning concern.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "Alexander... why are you so angry?"
Close-up of Alexander speaking through clenched teeth, barely containing his protective fury.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."
Medium shot of Juliana looking down sheepishly before raising her eyes.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I knew you would worry."
Tight close-up of Alexander, his voice trembling with terrified passion.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you."
Two-shot as Juliana looks up into his eyes, holding firm.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "But they didn't."
Close-up of their clasped hands, panning up to Alexander's tormented gaze.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "This time."

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I am being careful."
Two-shot as Juliana looks at him earnestly.

25.speaker: JULIANA
25.text: "I cannot abandon her."
Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.
Close-up of Alexander opening his piercing eyes, resignation and steadfast devotion washing over his features.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Then tell me everything."
Medium two-shot as Alexander holds her gaze in the twilight shadows.

25.speaker: ALEXANDER
25.text: "Everything you saw."
Alexander turns, falling into step beside Juliana. Together, side by side, they begin their quiet walk down the darkening forest path into the twilight.
Wide tracking shot from behind Alexander and Juliana as their silhouettes disappear into the shadowy, mist-veiled forest as emotional strings swell to a resolving chord.

26.text: Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.
Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.
Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.
The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."
Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."
Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."
Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "If the guards hear us, we are both dead."
Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
A sharp, stunned gasp.
Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.

26.speaker: JULIANA
26.text: "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "Do not move!"
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.

26.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
26.text: "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
Medium close-up of Juliana frozen in shock, her breath catching as the Duchess's desperate words echo in the silence of the room.

Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "This ring..."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "He is no commoner. What does he do?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "My lost son wore that ring!"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "Did your husband serve beside him?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
27.text: "What is your husband's name?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "She needed help."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "What are you hiding?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "Nothing."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "Show me your hand."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "Girl. Show me what you are holding."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "What is this?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "Medicine."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "Medicine? You are a new maid."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "No one."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "Then you administered it without permission."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "Because she was dying!"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "The physicians were not saving her!"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "My aunt has been wasting away for months."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "It is an antidote."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "An antidote to what?"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "Answer her."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "Poison."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "Poison."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "You hear that?!"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
27.text: "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: JULIANA
27.text: "That is not what I said!"

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "Enough."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
27.text: "Take her."

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.

27.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
27.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.

28.text: Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.
Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.
Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.
Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.
Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.
Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "Look at her, Rupert."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "Soot on her face..."
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "...herbs in her pockets..."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "...a secret medicine in her hand."
Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "She looks exactly like a poisoner."
Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "A clever story, girl."

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "Rupert..."
Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "Stop this!"
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "She is innocent."

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "She saved me!"
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "Your Grace..."
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "I know what happened to me!"
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "I was poisoned!"

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "And you... you knew!"
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "Catherine knew!"

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "They have been—"
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "Let me help her!"

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "You see?"

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "The poison has clearly damaged her mind."
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

28.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
28.text: "I am not delusional!"

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "Of course you are not."

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "You are merely confused."
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "No!"
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "Give it back!"

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "It belonged to my mother!"
Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows."
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.
Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "My mother's locket!"
Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "Juliana..."
Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "I knew I had seen those eyes before."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "The disgraced daughter..."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "...the girl thrown out of her own family home."
Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "The bride who married a penniless war veteran..."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "...because no respectable man would have her."
Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "Do not speak about my husband!"
Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

28.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
28.text: "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "And this?"

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

28.speaker: JULIANA
28.text: "That book is my mother's life's work!"
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."

28.speaker: CATHERINE
28.text: "...before he sends you to the gallows."
Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.

29.text: High angle tracking shot descending a spiral stone staircase illuminated by flickering wall torches and damp, glistening masonry.
Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.
Tracking shot facing two stern uniform guards hauling a struggling Juliana down the dark corridor by her arms.
Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.
Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!"
Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.
Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!"
Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.
Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "Your mother's little book of weeds?"

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "You still call this a legacy?"
Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "It is medicine!"
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "Of course."
Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand."
Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "The magistrate will call it witchcraft."
Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "You know that is a lie!"
Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "You cannot just destroy it!"
Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "I can burn it."
Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."
Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "...no one will remember what was written inside."
Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."
Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "You were cast out once."
Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "You should have stayed forgotten."
Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "My husband will find me."
Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "Your scarred soldier?"
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.

29.speaker: CATHERINE
29.text: "What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?"
Medium shot as the guard clamps a heavy hand on Juliana's shoulder, shoving her forward.

29.speaker: GUARD
29.text: "Move along, girl."
Wide shot tracking behind the guards as they march Juliana down the vaulted, puddle-strewn corridor toward the heavy iron cell door.
Wide shot inside the pitch-dark cell as the heavy iron door swings open.
The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "Please!"
The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
Static shot of the locked iron door, deadlocked in total isolation.
Medium close-up of Juliana kneeling on the floor, clutching her chest as hyperventilation overtakes her.
Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "Mother..."
Medium shot as Juliana pushes herself off the wet stone floor and dashes toward the barred wicket of the heavy door.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "I have done nothing!"
Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "I saved her! I healed her!"
Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.
Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "I saved the Duchess!"
Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "They took my mother's ledger..."
Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.

29.speaker: JULIANA
29.text: "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."
Close-up of the dungeon's massive iron portcullis bars dropping down with finality.
A heavy iron portcullis crashes down with a massive echoing bang.

Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana standing dignified in the center of the damp dungeon cell, gazing upward toward the overhead grate where faint beams of moonlight filter down, cutting sharply to black.

30.text: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.
Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.
The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.
Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.
A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.
Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."
Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."
Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."
Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "If she speaks..."
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "What are you suggesting?"
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "We stop hiding the prisoner."
Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "We give them a reason to condemn her."
Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

30.speaker: CATHERINE
30.text: "You have a solution?"
Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "We use the law to destroy her."
Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "The law?"
Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber."
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner."
Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

30.speaker: CATHERINE
30.text: "And if she claims she is a healer?"
Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Then call it witchcraft."
Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "Witchcraft is a capital charge."
Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Precisely."
Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."
Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

30.speaker: CATHERINE
30.text: "Her botanical ledger..."
Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Exactly."
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

30.speaker: CATHERINE
30.text: "And the Dowager?"
Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "And Juliana?"
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.

30.speaker: CATHERINE
30.text: "She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."
Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.

30.speaker: RUPERT
30.text: "I will write the arrest warrant myself."
Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

30.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
30.text: "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."

30.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
30.text: High-angle shot peering down through the heavy iron dungeon grate into the flooded, pitch-black subterranean wet cells where water drips continuously.

30.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
30.text: Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.

30.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
30.text: Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Juliana huddled against the wet stone wall, chained by the wrists, shivering in wet rags as faint moonlight filters down through the grate above.

30.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
30.text: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Look at you."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "You seem very pleased."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "I am."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Do you remember?"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "Gerald chose money."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "Clarissa chose a coward."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "I chose myself."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "You chose a beggar."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "I chose a man."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "A scarred nobody."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "You call that marriage?"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "I call it love."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "You think love makes you better than me?"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "Enough!"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "[gasping] Give it back!"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: JULIANA
31.text: "No!"

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.speaker: CATHERINE
31.text: "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

31.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
31.text: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

32.text: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "There it is."
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "Fear."
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "You have been so proud of that brave little face..."
Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "...but now you are afraid."
Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "Say goodbye to your mother."
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "Burn it."
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "What?"
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "You may destroy the book..."
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "You still think you are better?!"
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "I know what I am."
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "A disgraced woman?"
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

32.speaker: CATHERINE
32.text: "You are lying!"
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

32.speaker: JULIANA
32.text: "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
