44.text: Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY
44.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
44.text: "I have more than enough."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
44.text: "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
44.text: "Do something!"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "Alexander... I thought you had died."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "Do you know what this did to me?"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "I mourned you."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "I waited for you."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "I never stopped loving you."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "You don't remember?"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: ALEXANDER
44.text: "You were never my Duchess."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "But I loved you!"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: ALEXANDER
44.text: "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "No!"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "I loved you before all this!"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: ALEXANDER
44.text: "Did you?"

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

44.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
44.speaker: CATHERINE
44.text: "Her?!"

45.text: Full tracking shot following behind Alexander as he walks down the rubble-covered stone aisle toward Juliana.
Alexander strides purposefully down the cathedral aisle, ignoring the watching nobles as Juliana stands shackled in her rustic grey dress near the entrance.
Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, tears welling in her eyes.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "Alexander..."
Medium shot as Alexander stops in front of Juliana and sinks onto one knee before her.
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "Look at me."
Low angle close-up of Juliana looking down into Alexander's eyes with rising disbelief.
Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.
Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "Your eyes..."
Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.
Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "It's you."

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "It was always me."
Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "You're the Duke?"
Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "All this time?"
Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "I chose you because you were kind."

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "You chose me when I had nothing."
Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "I chose you because you had honor."
Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

45.speaker: JULIANA
45.text: "I loved you before I ever knew who you were."

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."
Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

45.speaker: CATHERINE
45.text: "Alexander..."
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

45.speaker: CATHERINE
45.text: "I didn't know!"

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

45.speaker: CATHERINE
45.text: "Wife?!"
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "Before the Crown and before God..."
Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.
Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.

45.speaker: ALEXANDER
45.text: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"
Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.

45.speaker: RUPERT
45.text: "Juliana?!"
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing proudly together, exchanging a loving gaze amid the awestruck crowd.
Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

45.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
45.text: "No one will bow yet!"
Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

45.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
45.text: "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

45.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
45.text: "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.

45.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
45.text: "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.

45.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
45.text: "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.
Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.
Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.
Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.

46.text: Full shot of Alexander and Juliana standing side by side before the altar, their hands tightly clasped beneath the soaring stained-glass windows.
Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.
Medium close-up of an elderly noblewoman seated in the pew, clutching her chest with anxious apprehension.
Medium shot of Catherine in her lavish bridal gown, her fists clenched tightly in silent fury.
Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.
Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.
Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.
Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."
Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."
Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.
Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

46.speaker: ALEXANDER
46.text: "She married the man... not the title."
Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."
Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "No licensed clergyman presided..."
Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."
Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."
Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "I won't ask it for permission to love."
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "Then look at this floor honestly, for once."

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "A church called me unworthy."
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "A church chained me."
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"

46.speaker: JULIANA
46.text: "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

46.speaker: CATHERINE
46.text: "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

46.speaker: ALEXANDER
46.text: "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

46.speaker: ALEXANDER
46.text: "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."

46.speaker: ALEXANDER
46.text: "I'll take that wager over your decree."
Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

46.speaker: ALEXANDER
46.text: "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

46.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
46.text: "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."
The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.
Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.

46.speaker: CATHERINE
46.text: "Ten days is plenty of time."

47.text: Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.
Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.

47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."
Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.

47.speaker: CONSPIRATOR
47.text: "Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry."
Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.

47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls."
Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.

47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest."
Atmospheric wide pan across the spacious master bedroom, daylight spilling softly through tall Gothic windows onto the hearth fire.
Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.

47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?"
Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.

47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "What if they strip your title? Because of me?"
Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.

47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."
Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.

47.speaker: ALEXANDER
47.text: "Look at me, Juliana."
Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.

47.speaker: ALEXANDER
47.text: "You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."
Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.

47.speaker: ALEXANDER
47.text: "You are my wife."
Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

47.speaker: ALEXANDER
47.text: "You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."
Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.
Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

47.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
47.text: "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.

47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.

47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.

47.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
47.text: "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.

47.speaker: VAUGHN
47.text: "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

47.speaker: ALEXANDER
47.text: "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "Stop."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: ALEXANDER
47.text: "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "She did."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "You want me? As a guest?"

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "As a scullery maid."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "You humiliate me."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: JULIANA
47.text: "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.speaker: CATHERINE
47.text: "I accept, Your Grace."

47.scene_heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
47.text: Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.

48.text: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.
Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Ten days for the council to sit."
Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."
Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "And doors can be closed from the other side."
Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.
Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.

48.speaker: AGNES
48.text: "You sent for me, my lady?"

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Lock it."
Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Good. Let them remember it."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.

48.speaker: AGNES
48.text: "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

48.speaker: AGNES
48.text: "If someone sees him come to you..."
Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Then no one sees him."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "That is precisely your job tonight."
Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "Send for the priest. Tonight."

48.speaker: CATHERINE
48.text: "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.

Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.

49.text: Wide tracking shot down a dark, derelict hallway lined with dust-sheet draped furniture and peeling wallpaper. At the far end, a door creaks open, revealing a cloaked figure stepping in.
Hinges creaking softly followed by the muffled thud of a heavy wooden door clicking shut.
Father Thomas, clad in a hooded dark mantle over priestly black robes, secures the door behind him and steps into the shadows of the abandoned corridor.
Medium shot on Catherine, draped in a dark hooded cloak over a lavish crimson bodice, holding a brass candlestick aloft.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "You took your time."
Over-the-shoulder shot past Father Thomas's cloaked back looking toward Catherine illuminated in warm candlelight.
Medium close-up of Father Thomas under his black hood, his stern face framed by the clerical collar and silver crucifix resting on his chest.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables."
Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Good. That's what I pay her for."
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.
Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.
Tight close-up on Father Thomas's face, the candlelight dancing in his calculating eyes.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing."
Close-up on Catherine, her blonde ringlets peeking from beneath her velvet hood as she smiles faintly.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough."
Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well."
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way."
Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her."
Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember."
Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "You always did have a taste for symbolism."
Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other."
Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour."
Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once."
Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene."
Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."
Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.
Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet."
Close-up on Father Thomas looking down into her eyes.

49.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
49.text: "Then we understand each other."
Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.
Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.

49.speaker: CATHERINE
49.text: "We always have."
Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.

50.text: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.
Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.

50.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
50.text: "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "Name your price."
Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

50.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
50.text: "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.

50.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
50.text: "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

50.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
50.text: "For as long as it holds."
Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."
Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

50.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
50.text: "I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."
Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "In another room no one uses?"

50.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
50.text: "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.

50.speaker: CATHERINE
50.text: "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.
Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.
Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.
Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.
Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.
Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
